# Netanya Properties

> An independent guide to established real estate developers active in Netanya, Israel — their backgrounds, areas of activity and official websites.

Netanya Properties is an independent editorial directory. It is not a real estate agency or broker, does not sell property and is not affiliated with the companies it profiles.

## Developer profiles
- [Azorim](https://www.netanya-properties.com/developers/azorim/): Azorim is a Tel Aviv Stock Exchange-listed residential developer that has been building homes across Israel for around six decades.
- [Aura Israel](https://www.netanya-properties.com/developers/aura/): Aura is a Tel Aviv Stock Exchange-listed developer that concentrates on urban renewal, replacing ageing housing blocks with new residential districts.
- [Africa Israel Residences](https://www.netanya-properties.com/developers/africa-israel/): Africa Israel Residences is the TASE-listed homebuilding arm of the Africa Israel group, known for its Savyonim-branded residential communities.
- [Ashtrom Residences](https://www.netanya-properties.com/developers/ashtrom/): Ashtrom Residences, formerly Ashdar, is the wholly owned residential development arm of the TASE-listed Ashtrom Group.
